extra_vocab.zh: 替換品、更換品；接替的人
extra_vocab.en: a new thing that you get to take the place of one that is broken or lost
extra_vocab.note:
在這篇通話裡，replacement 指客服免費寄給顧客的新馬克杯，用來取代那個有裂痕的杯子。後面的 How long will the replacement take? 也是問這個新品多久會送到。
【W2D2】在這篇裡放在 service 前面當形容詞用，replacement service 指原班列車改道後，用來「取代」它的替代班次。語氣中性，是交通公告常見用語。

example.en: We will send a replacement as soon as we get the broken item.
example.zh: 收到損壞的商品後，我們會立刻寄出替換品。

example.en: The technician ordered a replacement part for the copy machine.
example.zh: 技術人員為影印機訂了一個替換零件。

example.en: Customers are eligible for a free replacement within thirty days.
example.zh: 顧客在三十天內可享有免費更換。

example.en: The replacement cost is higher than the price of a new model.
example.zh: 更換費用比買一台新機型還貴。

example.en: A replacement service will run until the repairs are finished.
example.zh: 在維修完成前，會有替代班次行駛。

example.en: We must find a replacement before she leaves the company.
example.zh: 在她離開公司前，我們必須找到接替的人。

examples.en: If the mug is cracked, we can offer a replacement.
examples.zh: 如果馬克杯有裂痕，我們可以提供替換品。

examples.en: The warranty covers repair or replacement of faulty products.
examples.zh: 保固涵蓋有瑕疵產品的維修或更換。

examples.en: We need a replacement for the printer that stopped working.
examples.zh: 我們需要替換那台壞掉的印表機。

examples.en: The company is looking for a replacement for the sales manager.
examples.zh: 公司正在找人接替業務經理的職位。

examples.en: If the product is damaged, we will send a replacement.
examples.zh: 如果商品損壞，我們會寄出替換品。

examples.en: Please confirm the replacement order before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 請在本週結束前確認替換訂單。

examples.en: A replacement bus took passengers to the next station.
examples.zh: 一輛替代巴士載乘客前往下一站。

confusable.diff: refund 是把錢退還給你；replacement 是給你一個新的東西來取代舊的，不一定退錢。

example.en: The customer asked for a refund instead of a new item.
example.zh: 顧客要求退款，而不是換新的商品。

confusable.diff: substitute 多指暫時的代替品或代班的人；replacement 是長期取代原本的東西或人。

example.en: A substitute will cover the shift while she is away.
example.zh: 她不在時，會有代班人員接手這個班。

confusable.diff: alternative 是「另一個可選的方案」，原本的仍可使用；replacement 是原本的不能用了，由新的取代。

example.en: We offered an alternative model because the first was sold out.
example.zh: 因為第一款已售完，我們提供了另一款型號。

example.en: Please replace the old battery with a new one.
example.zh: 請把舊電池換成新的。

example.en: You can ask for a full refund within two weeks.
example.zh: 你可以在兩週內要求全額退款。

example.en: The damaged box was returned to the supplier.
example.zh: 受損的箱子被退回給供應商。

example.en: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
example.zh: 這台筆記型電腦附有兩年保固。

example.en: This part is replaceable, so repairs are easy.
example.zh: 這個零件可以更換，所以維修很容易。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；re-（再）+ place（放），把新的放回原位；replace + -ment 變成名詞「替換品」，像 payment、agreement

senses.en: a new thing that takes the place of one that is broken or lost

example.en: The supplier will ship a replacement for the faulty printer today.
example.zh: 供應商今天會寄出替換那台故障印表機的新品。

senses.en: a person who takes over another person's job
senses.distinguish: 談人事、離職、徵才時，指接任者。

example.en: We are interviewing candidates as a replacement for our accountant.
example.zh: 我們正在面試應徵者，要接替我們的會計。

senses.en: the act of putting a new thing in place of an old one
senses.distinguish: 常接 of + 舊物，如 the replacement of the old servers，指「換」這個動作。

example.en: The replacement of the old servers will take two days.
example.zh: 更換舊伺服器需要兩天的時間。

extra_vocab.en: a special offer or activity to help sell a product
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是「促銷活動」的意思（spring promotion），指商店在特定季節推出的優惠活動。多益中 promotion 也常指「升遷」，要看上下文判斷。

example.en: The store will run a promotion during the holiday season.
example.zh: 這家店會在假期期間舉辦促銷活動。

example.en: Enter your promotion code at checkout to get a discount.
example.zh: 結帳時輸入優惠碼即可享有折扣。

example.en: Our sales promotion helped increase online orders last month.
example.zh: 我們的促銷活動讓上個月的網路訂單增加了。

example.en: She received a promotion after two years in the sales team.
example.zh: 她在業務團隊工作兩年後獲得升遷。

examples.en: The promotion ends on Friday, so please order soon.
examples.zh: 促銷活動週五結束，所以請盡快下單。

examples.en: Mr. Lee is being considered for a promotion this year.
examples.zh: 李先生今年正被考慮升遷。

confusable.diff: discount 是「折扣」本身；promotion 是整個促銷活動，可能包含折扣、贈品或限時優惠。

example.en: The store gave us a ten percent discount on bulk orders.
example.zh: 這家店對大量訂購給了我們九折優惠。

example.en: We plan to promote the new product on social media.
example.zh: 我們打算在社群媒體上宣傳這項新產品。

example.en: The promotional items were given out at the event.
example.zh: 促銷品在活動中發送出去。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；promote + -ion，把「促銷、升遷」變成名詞，像 donate → donation

senses.en: a special offer or activity to help sell a product

example.en: The holiday promotion offers free shipping on all online orders.
example.zh: 假期促銷活動提供所有線上訂單免運費。

senses.en: a move to a higher job in a company
senses.distinguish: 前後文談員工、職稱、薪水時指升遷；談商品、折扣時指促銷。

example.en: Ms. Wu earned a promotion to regional sales manager this month.
example.zh: 吳小姐這個月升任區域業務經理。

senses.en: the work of making people know about a product or event
senses.distinguish: 常見 the promotion of + 產品或活動，指推廣這件事。

example.en: The company spent a large budget on the promotion of its new brand.
example.zh: 公司花了一大筆預算宣傳它的新品牌。

extra_vocab.en: a thin line on a surface where something has started to break
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是名詞，指杯子上的「裂痕」（with a crack in it），用來說明商品抵達時已有瑕疵。客訴情境中很常見。

example.en: There is a crack in the glass door at the entrance.
example.zh: 入口處的玻璃門上有一道裂縫。

example.en: I would like to return this phone because of the cracked screen.
example.zh: 因為螢幕破裂，我想退回這支手機。

example.en: A good manager does not crack under pressure.
example.zh: 好的主管不會在壓力下崩潰。

examples.en: The customer sent a photo showing a crack on the plate.
examples.zh: 顧客寄來一張照片，顯示盤子上有裂痕。

examples.en: A small crack appeared in the wall after the repair work.
examples.zh: 維修工程後，牆上出現了一道小裂縫。

examples.en: The cup cracked when it fell off the table.
examples.zh: 杯子從桌上掉下來時裂開了。

confusable.diff: break 是「破掉、斷掉」，通常已經分開；crack 只是出現裂痕，物體可能還連在一起。

example.en: Be careful, or you will break the glass on the display.
example.zh: 小心點，否則你會打破展示櫃的玻璃。

confusable.diff: scratch 是表面的刮痕；crack 是較深的裂縫，可能影響結構。

example.en: There is a small scratch on the surface of the table.
example.zh: 桌子表面有一道小刮痕。

example.en: Please do not use a cracked cup for customers.
example.zh: 請不要給顧客使用有裂痕的杯子。

example.en: Be careful not to break the glass items.
example.zh: 小心不要打破玻璃製品。

example.en: The inspector found a small crack in the main water pipe.
example.zh: 檢查員在主水管上發現一道小裂縫。

example.en: The plastic cover may crack if it gets too hot.
example.zh: 塑膠外蓋太熱時可能會裂開。

extra_vocab.en: a piece of paper or plastic on a product or package with information on it
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是 return label（退貨標籤），指貼在包裹上、印有退貨地址與追蹤條碼的標籤。顧客列印後貼在包裹上即可寄回。

example.en: Print the shipping label and attach it to the box.
example.zh: 請列印運送標籤並貼在箱子上。

example.en: Please read the label before using this cleaning product.
example.zh: 使用這項清潔產品前，請先閱讀標籤。

example.en: The price label on the shelf is not correct.
example.zh: 架上的價格標籤不正確。

examples.en: Each box must have a label with the order number.
examples.zh: 每個箱子都必須貼有印著訂單編號的標籤。

examples.en: Please label all the boxes before they leave the warehouse.
examples.zh: 請在所有箱子離開倉庫前貼上標籤。

confusable.diff: tag 常是掛在商品上的吊牌；label 通常是貼在商品或包裹上的標籤或貼紙。

example.en: Please attach a tag to each suitcase before check-in.
example.zh: 辦理報到前，請在每個行李箱上掛一個吊牌。

confusable.diff: sticker 是一般貼紙，不一定有資訊；label 一定帶有資訊。

example.en: The children received a sticker after the tour.
example.zh: 導覽結束後，孩子們拿到一張貼紙。

example.en: All the samples are clearly labeled by date.
example.zh: 所有樣品都依日期清楚標示。

example.en: The labeling on the package must be easy to read.
example.zh: 包裹上的標示必須容易閱讀。

derived.link: mis-（錯誤）+ label，貼錯標籤，像 misunderstand、mistake
re-（再次）+ label，重新貼標，像 rewrite、return

example.en: The product label lists all ingredients and the expiration date.
example.zh: 產品標籤列出所有成分和有效期限。

example.en: Staff must label each sample with the date and name.
example.zh: 員工必須在每個樣品上標示日期和姓名。

senses.en: a piece of paper or plastic on a product or package with information on it

example.en: Please check the label for washing and storage instructions.
example.zh: 請查看標籤上的清洗與保存說明。

senses.en: a brand name used on products
senses.distinguish: 常見 private label、own label，指商品的品牌，而不是貼在上面的紙。

example.en: The store sells its own label of coffee at a lower price.
example.zh: 這家店以較低的價格販售自有品牌的咖啡。

extra_vocab.en: having official permission to do something or to be used
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在名詞前（authorized shipping center），指「經公司認可的收件點」，不是隨便一間快遞店都可以。商務文件中常用來說明只有被允許的人或地點才能做某事。

example.en: You can buy this brand only from an authorized dealer.
example.zh: 你只能向授權經銷商購買這個品牌。

example.en: Only authorized personnel may enter the storage room.
example.zh: 只有授權人員可以進入儲藏室。

example.en: Ms. Chen is authorized to approve purchases up to $500.
example.zh: 陳小姐被授權可核准五百美元以內的採購。

examples.en: Please take the printer to an authorized service center.
examples.zh: 請把印表機送到授權服務中心。

examples.en: Only authorized users can view the company's financial reports.
examples.zh: 只有授權使用者才能查看公司的財務報告。

confusable.diff: official 強調「正式的、官方的」；authorized 強調「被允許、被授權」做某事。

example.en: The official report will be released next week.
example.zh: 正式的報告將在下週發布。

confusable.diff: approved 是「被核准的」（通過審查）；authorized 是「被授予權限的」。

example.en: The approved budget covers all training costs.
example.zh: 核准的預算涵蓋所有培訓費用。

example.en: The manager must authorize every large purchase.
example.zh: 經理必須批准每一筆大額採購。

example.en: You need written authorization to enter this area.
example.zh: 你需要書面許可才能進入這個區域。

example.en: Unauthorized use of this system is not allowed.
example.zh: 不得未經授權使用此系統。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；作者對自己的作品有最高的權力，author + -ize（使成為）→ authorize，給人權力
author + -ity，名詞字尾，像 security、activity；表示「有權力的人或單位」
authorize + -ation，把「授權」這個動作變成名詞，像 organize → organization

example.en: Only authorized drivers may use the company vehicles.
example.zh: 只有經授權的駕駛才可以使用公司車輛。

example.en: The director must authorize any spending over one thousand dollars.
example.zh: 任何超過一千美元的支出都必須由主任批准。

senses.en: having official permission to do something or to be used

example.en: The authorized signer must sign every purchase contract.
example.zh: 經授權的簽署人必須簽署每一份採購合約。

senses.en: to give someone the official power to do something
senses.distinguish: 句型是 authorize + 人 + to V。

example.en: The manager authorized her assistant to sign the delivery forms.
example.zh: 經理授權她的助理簽署送貨單。

senses.distinguish: 受詞是款項、計畫、購買等事物，如 authorize a payment。

example.en: The finance team authorized the payment this morning.
example.zh: 財務團隊今天早上批准了這筆付款。

extra_vocab.en: broken or harmed so that it cannot work or look normal
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在名詞前（the damaged mug），指運送途中受損的商品。客訴與退換貨情境中常見，通常搭配 return、replace、report 等動詞。

example.en: We cannot sell damaged goods to our customers.
example.zh: 我們不能把受損商品賣給顧客。

example.en: Several boxes arrived damaged because of heavy rain.
example.zh: 因為大雨，好幾個箱子抵達時已受損。

example.en: Please report damaged items within seven days of delivery.
example.zh: 請在送達後七天內通報受損品項。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to our warehouse roof.
example.zh: 暴風雨對我們倉庫的屋頂造成嚴重損壞。

examples.en: We will replace any damaged product free of charge.
examples.zh: 我們會免費更換任何受損的產品。

examples.en: The insurance does not cover water damage.
The heavy box damaged the floor in the lobby.
examples.zh: 那個沉重的箱子損壞了大廳的地板。

confusable.diff: defective 指商品本身有製造瑕疵；damaged 指之後因碰撞、運送等原因受損。

example.en: The factory replaced the defective switches free of charge.
example.zh: 工廠免費更換了有瑕疵的開關。

confusable.diff: broken 是已經壞掉、無法使用；damaged 範圍較廣，可能只是部分受損。

example.en: The broken printer has not worked since Monday.
example.zh: 那台壞掉的印表機從星期一起就不能用了。

example.en: Please send us a photo of the damage.
example.zh: 請寄給我們一張損壞處的照片。

example.en: The bad review was damaging to the company's image.
example.zh: 那則負面評論對公司形象有害。

example.en: The rest of the order arrived undamaged.
example.zh: 訂單的其餘部分完好無損地送達。

derived.link: un-（不）+ damaged，沒有受損，像 unhappy、unable

example.en: Customers can return damaged items within thirty days of purchase.
example.zh: 顧客可在購買後三十天內退回受損商品。

example.en: The insurance report describes the damage to the delivery truck.
example.zh: 保險報告描述了送貨卡車的損壞情形。

example.en: Heavy rain damaged several boxes stored near the loading door.
example.zh: 大雨損壞了存放在裝貨門附近的幾個箱子。

senses.en: broken or harmed so that it cannot work or look normal

example.en: Please report any damaged packages to the shipping desk.
example.zh: 請向出貨櫃台通報任何受損的包裹。

senses.en: harm that is done to something
senses.distinguish: 不可數，常見 damage to、cause damage、water damage。

example.en: The fire caused serious damage to the storage building.
example.zh: 這場火災對儲存倉庫造成嚴重損害。

senses.en: money that a person or company must pay for harm they caused
senses.distinguish: 用複數 damages，常搭配 pay、claim、award，與不可數的 damage 不同。

example.en: The supplier agreed to pay damages for the late delivery.
example.zh: 供應商同意為延遲交貨支付損害賠償金。
